# Vladimir Siedykh

> > Technical consulting and strategic guidance for B2B SaaS architecture, business website development, and AI security compliance.

Vladimir Siedykh provides in-depth technical articles and frameworks for business leaders, covering SaaS product architecture, web development project management, compliance (GDPR, OWASP, SOC 2, ISO 42001), and data-driven decision-making. The site serves CTOs, product managers, and business owners navigating complex technical decisions in Germany and EU markets.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Architecture
- GDPR Compliance
- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
- Business Website ROI
- AI Security (ISO 42001, SOC 2)
- Stripe Integration
- Web Development Pricing
- Lead Qualification
- Conversion Optimization
- Feature Flags & Release Management
- Power BI & Business Intelligence
- Retention Signals
- B2B Entitlements
- Board Reporting Automation
- EU Market Web Development
